column2: Lilmoth Dock is a short pull east of here, passenger. It is a mess of small craft when you get there. Alten Merihall is a long haul down the coast, east-south-east. I charge for every channel on the way.

There is a longboat drawn up on the bank, a short walk south. Lifts-The-Sacks is the only hand here who loads a boat properly. I would sooner trust him with a boat than the soldiers, Sees-No-Shade and Rakhee-Tul.

Lilmoth sits over shallow water, so the big ships cannot dock. They anchor out. Boats like mine carry the goods in. Since Lilmoth fell, Alten Merihall has taken much of the bay's outside trade. That is more water for the rest of us to cross.

There is a large ship on the shore, a short walk south. A captain's journal and some armour lie beside it, a little nearer. Her crew lost her and still say she ran herself aground. Go and look, passenger. Judge the water for yourself.

I am Reads-The-Shallows. I run a flat boat with the plantation's rice to Lilmoth. I know every channel between here and the walls. I am waiting for a full load and a fair wind. I would rather leave before the steward changes his mind about the price.
